messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "especially heart or blood pressure medication"
set: ["especially heart or blood pressure medication", "blood pressure medication", "blood pressure or heart rate", "inform doctor when starting or stopping heart or blood pressure medication", "heart problems or high blood pressure", "heart medication", "long-term use of blood pressure medication", "blood pressure", "other medicines that lower blood pressure or heart rate", "check blood pressure and heart rate regularly", "stroke or high blood pressure", "tell doctor about all other heart or blood pressure medications", "inform doctor or pharmacist if taking other heart or blood pressure medications", "lowered blood pressure", "lower blood pressure", "blood pressure rebound"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
